children: Hemab appointed Keli Walbert to its Board as a Class I director and named her to the Audit Committee, effective immediately.
Member of the Board (Class I); Member of the Audit Committee
Elected by the Board upon recommendation of the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee

Option to purchase 36,000 shares (vesting monthly over 3 years; accelerated on change in control); $40,000 annual board cash retainer; $10,000 annual Audit Committee cash retainer; annual equity grants per policy; reimbursement of meeting-related expenses

No arrangements or understandings with others regarding election; no family relationships with directors/officers; no transactions requiring Item 404 disclosure; will enter standard indemnification agreement
